svg.title: From acceptance to closing
svg.desc: The committee accepts a phase. Finance reads waiting phases and calls the payment gate, and a pass creates the voucher. Approval records the payment on the ledger and tells procurement in one transaction. The GFMIS file leaves through the outbox. A payment result raises voucher.paid. Imported reports record disbursement, then the period closes.
